verdict.rationale: Obsidian's docs describe a plugin API, a URI scheme for triggering single actions, and various core plugins (templates, daily notes, bases), but there is no evidence of a built-in rule/automation engine that fires actions automatically on events (e.g., 'on note create, run X'). Community plugins that provide this (e.g., QuickAdd, Templater triggers) are not cited in the evidence pack.
